harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (bootstrapped busybox-extras httpd on :8080, bound to node2's private-network address, persisted via OpenRC) through node1 (OpenWrt) via a firewall DNAT redirect (port 80 -> 10.100.29.11:8080) plus a hairpin SNAT rule, so node3 can reach the service at node1's management address on port 80 while the service stays on the private network. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and post-restart service/config recovery verified on each.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1 OpenWrt 25.12.2 (10.100.29.10/24, single br-lan), node2 Alpine (10.100.29.11/24, no HTTP service running yet), node3 Alpine (10.100.29.12/24) - all on one flat subnet

Installed busybox-extras on node2, created /var/www/index.html, wrote OpenRC init script /etc/init.d/mini-httpd running busybox-extras httpd -f -p 10.100.29.11:8080 -h /var/www, enabled via rc-update, started service
On node1 added uci firewall redirect 'Publish-node2-8080' (src=lan, src_dport=80, proto=tcp, DNAT to 10.100.29.11:8080), committed and reloaded firewall

Diagnosed asymmetric-routing hang on first node3->node1:80 test (node2 replied directly to node3, bypassing node1) and fixed it by adding uci firewall SNAT rule 'Hairpin-SNAT-node2' (rewrites source to 10.100.29.10 for traffic destined to 10.100.29.11:8080), committed and reloaded
Verified node3 curl to http://10.100.29.10:80/ repeatedly returns node2's content with HTTP 200
Captured pre-restart boot_id baselines and service health on all three nodes

Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id (87459890->9244d9c4), verified uci/nft rules persisted, verified end-to-end node3->node1:80 worked post-restart

Restarted node2 via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id (41e0f8ee->7f13ed47), verified mini-httpd auto-started and served content, verified end-to-end path via node1 worked post-restart
Restarted node3 via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id (5e511af4->68b8a535), verified it could still reach the published service on node1:80 post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 HTTP service exists on 8080 bound to private-network address
evidence.summary: busybox-extras installed, httpd started on 10.100.29.11:8080 via OpenRC service, confirmed listening and serving content

evidence.requirement: node1 DNAT redirect publishes port 80 -> node2:8080
evidence.summary: uci firewall redirect committed, nft ruleset shows dnat rule dport 80 -> 10.100.29.11:8080

evidence.requirement: hairpin SNAT fix for same-subnet asymmetric routing
evidence.summary: Diagnosed DNAT-only hang (curl timeout), added SNAT rule to rewrite source to node1's IP so replies route back through node1

evidence.requirement: node3 can reach service via node1 mgmt address:80
evidence.summary: node3 curl to http://10.100.29.10:80/ returns node2's content with HTTP 200, repeated 3x successfully

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 87459890-8426-4fd1-944e-ced0f4f9e1d0 and firewall config state pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged, node briefly unreachable (SSH timeout), reappeared with new boot_id 9244d9c4-55fc-4c7b-ac8d-3559fd47f85c

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of config and service
evidence.summary: uci/nft firewall rules (DNAT + SNAT) persisted after reboot; end-to-end curl from node3 through node1 to node2 succeeded post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 41e0f8ee-860b-46f9-a1e7-f51839b9955b and confirmed mini-httpd running and serving content pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged, connection reset confirming reboot in progress, node reappeared with new boot_id 7f13ed47-85dd-43bd-a014-283f9f5b22e9

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of service and data
evidence.summary: mini-httpd auto-started post-reboot (OpenRC default runlevel) and served original content; end-to-end path via node1 verified working

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 5e511af4-6a67-4b5a-b3d8-1f447f7ecc54 pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged, connection reset confirming reboot, node reappeared with new boot_id 68b8a535-7833-4271-bf5e-fea4c17c7d0c

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery and continued access to published service
evidence.summary: After restart, node3 regained its IP and successfully curled node1:80 to receive node2's content (HTTP 200)
